additionalProperties.description_en:
The GCS data format.
Single-line text log: `{"type":"Line"}`
CSV:

```
{
  "type": "CSV",
  "fieldDelimiter": ",",   // Delimiter
  "quoteChar": "\"",      // Quote character
  "escapeChar": "\",    // Escape character
  "firstRowAsHeader": true,    // Whether the first row is used as field names
  "maxLines": 1,    // Maximum number of lines a log entry can span
  "skipLeadingRows": 0   // Number of rows to skip
}

```
- Single-line JSON: `{"type": "JSON"}`
Multi-line text log:

```
{
  "type": "Multiline",
  "match": "after", // Regex match position
  "pattern": "\d+", // Regular expression
  "maxLines": 10 // Maximum number of lines
}
```
- JSON array: `{"type": "jsonarray"}`
Cloudtrail: `{"type": "cloudtrail"}`
additionalProperties.description_zh:
GCS数据格式。
单行文本日志：`{"type":"Line"}`
CSV：

```
{
  "type": "CSV",
  "fieldDelimiter": ",",   //分隔符
  "quoteChar": "\"",      //引号
  "escapeChar": "\\",    //转义符
  "firstRowAsHeader": true,    //首行是否作为字段名称
  "maxLines": 1,    //日志最大跨行数
  "skipLeadingRows": 0   //跳过行数
}

```
- 单行JSON：`{"type": "JSON"}`
跨行文本日志：

```
{
  "type": "Multiline",
  "match": "after", //正字匹配位置
  "pattern": "\\d+", //正则表达式
  "maxLines": 10 //最大行数
}
```
- JSON数组：`{"type": "jsonarray"}`
Cloudtrail：`{"type": "cloudtrail"}`
